description: Domain of storms, thunder, and lightning.

features.name: Tempest Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: fog cloud, thunderwave. Proficiency in heavy armor and martial weapons.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add WIS modifier to damage of cleric cantrips.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: Add CHA modifier to damage of one spell.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: Creatures near you take lightning damage when hitting you.
